comment_regular: Oblivion CTreeFileAccess::PeekToken. Bounds-checks byteBufferBegin/cursorOffset/byteBufferEnd, returns the little-endian dword at the current cursor without advancing it. CTreeEngine::Parse uses the result to detect optional token 0x1B58 before consuming it; RT4.1 FileAccess.cpp corroborates PeekToken after this behavior was established.
